purpose: RX CW input power calibration, not TX calibration
reference_plane: XM500 J1 input connector, cable-end power characterized with4025G before connecting to J1
power_estimator: energy-normalized power summed around expected CW frequency; noise-off subtraction from the same bins
rx_profile: ADC Tile1 physicalADC1/public RFDC block1, XM500 J1; RFDC decimation2 + existing PL8x
calibration_source: measured cable-end reference; never treat nominal source display as exact connector power
scope: Initial single-frequency CW only. No full-band, other FFT modes, channel/noise/QAM total-power or <0.1dB absolute accuracy claim.
rf_state_evidence: User confirms RF OFF after p07, SMB to J1, J7 empty

excluded_reference_points.p02: Observed three-reading span 0.15dB exceeds project 0.1dB screening threshold; keep raw readings, no forced repeat requested.
